items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
items.description:
Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography.

Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produce an output or response.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Monitor tab
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description:
We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.

The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment.

The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, permissions, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching.

items.title: PowerPoint:  Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Web)
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Windows Desktop)
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint file
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, screenshots of tables in Excel, or whiteboard photos in PowerPoint — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
items.description:
Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across the organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
items.description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a compliant MCP server.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
items.description: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
items.description: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions. Approval requests appear inline in the channel where the agent is deployed, including Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
items.description: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. This service also provides organizational data for use across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps to power various features with robust data quality framework that detects, communicates, and provides solutions for data quality issues before data is used.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.

items.title: Excel: Excel canvas
items.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: SharePoint: Site Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: The feature introduces enhanced Site Skills management capabilities, including skill editing, version control, publishing, restoration, and cross-site duplication, enabling organizations to govern and reuse skills more effectively across SharePoint sites.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
items.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new GHCP harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Data Quality Report for Profile Data
items.description: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services is introducing a new data quality report that helps administrators assess the coverage and health of people data used across Microsoft 365 experiences. High-quality people data enables users to more effectively discover and learn about colleagues through experiences such as the People Card, Org Explorer, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Cowork. The new report provides organizational data administrators, People Administrators, and AI Administrators with visibility into the completeness and quality of people attributes available in Microsoft 365. Administrators can use these insights to identify data gaps, improve attribute coverage, and help ensure users and AI-powered experiences have access to accurate organizational information. Key benefits: - Monitor the health and completeness of people profile attributes across the organization. - Identify missing or incomplete organizational data that may impact user and AI experiences. - Improve discoverability and organizational understanding in People Card and Org Explorer. - Help increase the effectiveness of Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Cowork by improving the quality of underlying people data. This feature is available to Organizational Data Administrators, People Administrators, and AI Administrators through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
items.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
items.description: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios. Copilot memory includes saved memories and details inferred from chat history that enable more personalized and context-aware Copilot experiences. Copilot memory items are stored in a hidden folder in the user’s Exchange mailbox. This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copilot experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
items.description: M365 Copilot now supports Writing blocks. Edit drafts, memos, emails, and more inline while using Chat for easy editing and iteration.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
items.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Improvements to agent evaluations experience
items.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior. New capabilities include richer evaluation explanations, agent reasoning traces, cited knowledge sources, evaluation run comparison, support for larger datasets, customizable test generation, and dataset generation from knowledge sources. These improvements help makers identify quality issues more quickly, understand why evaluations succeed or fail, compare results across runs, and create higher quality evaluation datasets with less manual effort. Additional validation and guidance will help makers resolve configuration issues before running evaluations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
items.description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher agent and Microsoft 365 Chat, allowing users to bring data into their workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source
items.description: eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
items.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
items.description: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365):  JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: OneNote: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (DoD, GCC, GCC High)
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for DoD, GCC, and GCC High clouds now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Dataverse integration on Copilot Studio
items.description: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data. This enhancement allows organizations to leverage business-critical information stored in Dataverse—including records, customer data, operational data, and business application content—as a trusted knowledge source for agent experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS.

items.title: Outlook: Language support for Summarize in Classic Outlook
items.description: When the content language and the Outlook language do not match, you will be able to select a different language to view summarize Copilot responses.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. This enables organizations to bring business-critical information stored in Azure SQL into their agent experiences using the same knowledge-centric approach that customers already use across other supported knowledge sources. Azure SQL knowledge support represents another step toward a unified knowledge platform strategy, where customers can connect enterprise data sources through a common knowledge framework and leverage those sources consistently across agent experiences. It also strengthens the story for organizations seeking to build grounded, enterprise-ready AI solutions using existing Microsoft data assets.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
items.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the call.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
items.description: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot admin configuration assistance
items.description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability. Only available for Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
items.description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
items.description: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
items.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
items.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
items.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share Autonomous Agents to End Users (Run-Only)
items.description: Previously, autonomous agents could only be used and managed by makers, limiting their reach to the people who needed them. Run-only sharing enables makers to securely share autonomous agents with end users, allowing users to benefit from agent-driven automation without requiring edit permissions or ownership. This extends autonomous agent capabilities to a broader audience while maintaining governance and control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
items.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Unified Agent and App Installation Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
items.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center will be able to apply app and agent installation changes once and have them consistently enforced across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Previously, installation changes made in the Microsoft 365 admin center only applied to Outlook and Microsoft 365, while changes made in the Teams admin center only applied to Teams. With this update, app and agent installation is unified across all supported surfaces, enabling a more consistent and streamlined admin experience.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
items.description: Managers in organizations can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling them to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
items.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

items.title: SharePoint: Enterprise store plugins in Copilot in SharePoint
items.description:
Copilot in SharePoint now supports plugins from your enterprise store. A plugin can bundle skills, MCP servers, and other capabilities that extend what Copilot can do. Any plugin made available to your organization, whether installed tenant-wide by an admin or added by you, works directly in Copilot in SharePoint, all governed by your M365 admin.

For example, your organization can publish a company-wide accessibility plugin once and have it work consistently across all agentic products, including Copilot in SharePoint, so everyone gets the same accessible experience wherever they work.

items.title: SharePoint: Personal Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: Create your own personal skills in Copilot in SharePoint and use them anywhere you work. Personal skills travel with you across SharePoint sites and OneDrive—so a skill like document generation works everywhere without recreating it per site. You own your skills, saved as a markdown file in your OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 Dashboard in Insights
items.description: Customers can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling leaders to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enable express mode for flows invoked by an agent or app
items.description: Express mode ensures agents and apps receive timely and reliable responses by dramatically accelerating flow run times. This reduces flow failures, improves user experience, and eliminates costly interruptions caused by timeout issues. Organizations benefit from more dependable automations, higher adoption, and smoother operational workflows.

items.title: SharePoint: Create new workflows with Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: Describe a workflow intent such as "when files are set to status = Complete, post a message in my Teams chat" and Copilot in SharePoint will assemble the necessary triggers, conditions, and actions to setup your workflow. You can come back to Copilot in SharePoint at any time to make changes or click "Workflows" from the command bar to see your live workflow.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (Android)
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (Android) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Link meetings to CRM records automatically with AI
items.description: This feature saves you time by automatically connecting your meetings to the correct CRM records. You have the right deal insights at your fingertips when preparing for customer conversations, so you can focus less on updating records and more on selling with confidence and context.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enrich Sales agent meeting prep with more data sources
items.description: Walking into a customer meeting with incomplete context can mean missed risks, overlooked issues, and conversations that fall flat. With access to richer data, like service tickets, directly in your meeting prep, you can spot open issues and opportunities before the conversation starts. This insight helps you engage more meaningfully, build stronger relationships, and drive better sales outcomes.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add custom insights to record summaries in Sales agent
items.description: Sales agent gives you strong CRM-based account and opportunity summaries, but important context is often spread across non-CRM systems. With this capability, you can add insights from any application to enrich account and opportunity summaries in Sales agent, so sellers get a unified view of their accounts and deals in one place without switching applications.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage customers across multiple channels (web, voice, SMS & email)
items.description: A multi‑channel outreach capability, spanning web chat, voice, SMS, and email, is critical for meeting customers in the channel they naturally prefer and increasing the likelihood of timely engagement. By activating the agent across multiple surfaces, we ensure continuity of conversations, reduce drop‑off when a single channel fails, and support the FY27 goal of always‑on, end‑to‑end engagement from initial intent to close. This creates higher response rates, faster qualification, and a more seamless handoff to sales motions.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage prospects faster with Sales Agent-enriched leads
items.description:
To reach their sales goals, sales teams need to constantly generate enough pipeline. They need to decide which inbound leads to engage. This decision takes a lot of time because sellers must sift through large amounts of data across tools and data sources. This data includes information from internal systems like their CRM and external resources like the web and third-party data services.
Sales Agent handles the work of reviewing every available data source to create a comprehensive summary for each lead. As a seller, you can quickly decide whether to engage with a prospect or pass on them. Sales Agent reviews every lead in your queue and gathers information. It synthesizes insights that are specific to your business. At a glance, you can see if a lead is worth reaching out to and what they're interested in. Use this information to personalize your engagement with the prospect. With Sales Agent, you spend less time and get higher response rates, leading to a larger, more qualified pipeline.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use SharePoint lists as a knowledge source
items.description: Unlock the full value of your structured data by bringing SharePoint lists directly into your Microsoft Copilot Studio agents. With native support, customers can ground AI responses in up-to-date, business-critical data—such as tasks, inventory, customers, or operations—without manual data movement or complex integrations. This enables more accurate, context-aware copilots that reflect how your business runs, helping teams make faster decisions, reduce errors, and automate workflows with confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center - Usage reports - Copilot Chat for GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Copilot Chat. This report will include total active users, Copilot Chat usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center – New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report for GCC High & DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report will include total enabled and active users, Copilot usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Block the use of maker-provided credentials for authentication
items.description:
By blocking the use of maker's credentials by AI agents, admins can increase the security and compliance of agents in their organizations:
- Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive systems or data that the maker's credentials might have access to.
- Help organizations comply with data protection regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA) by ensuring only authorized identities are used for data access.
- Enable IT and security teams to enforce organizational policies around identity and access management.
- Increase trust among stakeholders and IT departments, making it easier to adopt AI agents at scale.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enforce safe sharing by detecting credential oversharing
items.description: This feature helps organizations reduce security risk by preventing agents and flows from being shared when they rely on unsafe identities, such as maker credentials. By detecting identity oversharing early and enforcing safe‑sharing policies at publish and share time, customers can avoid identity leakage, privilege escalation, and unintended access - while still allowing makers to build and iterate safely within approved guardrails.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Insights: Copilot Analytics - Cowork adoption and impact
items.description: Deeper insights into Cowork adoption and impact accessible from the new AI Cost dashboard and Copilot dashboard. Includes export capability. All metrics can be queried by analysts with the new AI cost query in advanced insights.

items.title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
items.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights for GitHub Copilot spend and usage
items.description: AI spend and usage insights for GitHub Copilot will be available on Viva Insights for managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), Global analysts and Microsoft Global administrators. They can track spend and make data-driven decisions for AI spend and usage in GitHub Copilot. The dashboard is enabled by default to ensure immediate access.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated Copilot Answers
items.description: Copilot Answers in Copilot Search (in the M365 Copilot App on web and desktop) will provide more concise responses and more prominently highlight the ability to continue in the conversation in Copilot chat on the right-hand sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Insights in Cowork and WorkIQ spend and usage
items.description: Insights into AI spend (Copilot credit usage) at a group or team level will be available in Viva Insights as a dashboard and in Advanced insights. The services in scope of this release are Cowork and Work IQ API. The dashboard experience is available to managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), the Insights analysts, and Global administrators and is enabled by default to ensure immediate access to usage-based cost insights. For users to be able to use Cowork or WorkIQ API, your tenant must have usage-based billing setup via Cost Management in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Leader access to tenant-wide data is out of scope for this release. The same insights will be available for Insights Analysts and Global Administrators in Advanced Insights.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills- removal and deletion admin control
items.description:
A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them full control to offboard from People Skills in support of data governance and compliance needs.
Once deletion is initiated, skills will no longer appear on user profile cards or be used across Microsoft 365 skills-based experiences such as Copilot and Viva. The control is admin-only with no automatic changes.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

items.title: Excel: Summarize text columns with Copilot
items.description: Copilot can analyze columns of text to generate related categories or tags. For example, Copilot will find the main themes in survey responses from open-ended questions.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
items.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Outlook Emails in Copilot Notebooks
items.description:
Outlook Emails as References in Copilot Notebooks bring email content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot in the conversations, decisions, and context that drive their work. 
By adding emails as knowledge sources, users can connect context from their emails directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
items.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
items.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot suggested rename
items.description:
Copilot Suggested Rename is an AI-powered OneDrive feature that automatically recommends clear, descriptive file names based on a file’s content—helping users organize and find their files more easily with minimal effort. What the feature does:
- Analyzes the content of a file to generate context-aware filename suggestions
- Presents 3 recommended names directly within the rename dialog
- Allows users to pick a suggestion with a single click
Where it shows up:
- Within the rename dialog for supported files
-  Within the post-upload toast notification when a single supported file is uploaded
Supported file types:
- Microsoft Office documents
Word (DOCX)
PowerPoint (PPTX)
Excel (XLSX)
- Other document formats
PDF
Markdown (MD)
- Images

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes.   Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place.  Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes.   The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account.   Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
items.description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
items.description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Declarative agents with Actions available in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. Using custom actions, declarative agents can call external systems, execute operations, and retrieve or update data, moving beyond Q&A to full task completion. These actions are powered through API plugins, MCP tools, and enterprise connectors, allowing seamless integration with line-of-business applications and services. The Copilot platform dynamically reasons over available actions and selects the appropriate tool to fulfill user intent, enabling multi-step workflows such as creating records, submitting requests, or triggering business processes within a single conversational flow

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: Outlook: Co-Authoring Highlight and Rewrite
items.description: Users can now collaborate with Copilot to make improvements to email drafts. Select a section of the draft and ask Copilot to make changes, like changing its length, tone, or structure.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat History Filtering by Copilot Experience
items.description: Users will now see chat history scoped to their current Copilot Chat endpoint, with the option to see ‘All chats’ view. We have chosen not to move forward with this feature. We apologize for the inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Researcher Agent Access
items.description: Allows developers to invoke the Researcher agent through the Work IQ endpoint to perform multi‑step analysis, deep reasoning, and synthesis across enterprise content as part of agentic workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Get actionable suggestions from Copilot in your Copilot Page
items.description: Request feedback from Copilot on your Page by selecting "Suggested edits" in the Copilot Shortcuts menu. Copilot will analyze the content on your page and provide actionable suggestions about what you can change to improve clarity and quality of your written content. You can then apply suggestions directly to the page.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
items.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows
items.description: Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into your agentic workflows with MCP support, accelerating extensibility while preserving workflow reliability. This integration improves reuse across agents and workflows, reduces duplication of integrations, and embraces an emerging open and extensible agent ecosystem.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use
items.description: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. Makers can build reusable, goal-oriented automations that adapt dynamically to website or app changes, while admins maintain governance through access controls, hosted browser management, and environment-level permissions.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
items.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dynamic Tool Discovery for Declarative Agents and Federated Copilot Connectors
items.description: We're introducing dynamic tool discovery for declarative agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Developers can now add, update, or retire tools on their MCP servers without republishing the agent - so end users get the latest agent capabilities immediately, with no deployment cycle in between. Support for federated Copilot connectors will be a fast follow to declarative agents at a later stage. Dynamic tool discovery is backed by Microsoft's enterprise RAI and security protections, and customers retain full control over agent deployment and availability to users and groups.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
items.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint list support in Agent Builder
items.description: Agent Builder now supports using a SharePoint list as a knowledge source for agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Makers can ground an agent in structured list data so users can ask questions and get responses based on information stored in a selected SharePoint list. For this release, each agent can reference one SharePoint list with up to 20,000 items, alongside other knowledge source types. Support for list attachments and lookup columns is not yet available.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot can analyze content shared on desktop screen and through mobile camera
items.description: Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps you make faster, more informed decisions by understanding context from what you share on screen or camera. Copilot can analyze visual inputs from shared desktop screens and provide detailed insights about the content. You can also use  vision on mobile during a real-time voice session to share your device camera, front or back, and ask questions about what is in front of you. Copilot analyzes the live camera feed or desktop screen in real time and provides spoken, context-aware answers grounded in work and web data.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – Enhancement of Loop and Copilot Pages in Review and Export
items.description: Improves eDiscovery workflows for Loop and Copilot pages by enabling full indexing of page content for keyword search within review sets and adding HTML format support for export from search.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Settings in classic Outlook for Windows
items.description: You will now be able to access different Copilot settings directly in classic Outlook for Windows.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics: Copilot usage snapshot PBI at day level with fresh data
items.description: A day level Copilot adoption Power BI report reflecting the most recent copilot activity & freshest insights.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in Forms - US Government clouds
items.description: Copilot in Forms is being enabled for Microsoft Forms in Government Cloud environments, bringing end-to-end AI assistance to forms, from creating a form, to refining and sending to analyzing results. This rollout includes key Copilot features such as: - Draft with Copilot - Distribution and monitoring - Copilot Insights - On-canvas Copilot features such as Rewrite question, Continue writing, Answer explanations, and more.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Insights and policy recommendations on Microsoft Copilot and AI Apps interactions for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Provide insights on Copilots and AI Apps usage and recommend retention policies for customers to govern their Copilots and AI App interactions. Updated September 15, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs – Unified REST Endpoint for Agents and Workflows
items.description: Introduces a new REST endpoint for Work IQ that serves as a unified entry point for invoking agents and workflows, providing a consistent, scalable alternative to legacy Copilot Chat endpoints.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs – Remote MCP Server Support
items.description: Supports connecting to remote MCP servers through the Work IQ endpoint, enabling agents to securely invoke external tools and services beyond the local runtime for richer, distributed agent orchestration.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs - Endpoints: Declarative Agent Access
items.description: Enables programmatic access to first‑party and tenant‑defined declarative agents via the Work IQ endpoint, allowing applications to trigger specialized agents for domain‑specific tasks within broader workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.

items.title: SharePoint: Authoritative Sites
items.description: Authoritative Sites feature empowers administrators to designate specific SharePoint sites as official, trusted sources of information. By classifying these sites as authoritative these high-quality, credible content, such as company news, policies, and updates, are prioritized across Copilot Chat and Copilot Search experiences

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
items.description:
We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint. 
Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields.
Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint.
This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs.
The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generated document along with file metadata such as location and status.

items.title: Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks
items.description:
Meetings as References in Copilot Notebooks bring Teams meeting content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot on the discussions, decisions, and context that drive their work. By adding meetings as knowledge sources, users can connect transcripts, notes, chats, and shared content directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. 

Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New dedicated License Requests page in Microsoft 365 Admin Center
items.description: We are introducing a new dedicated License Requests page in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center to help admins more easily discover, review, and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests submitted by users.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v. 149 - Unifying Copilot Chat policy controls
items.description: The Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policy is becoming the standard for configuring Copilot Chat. Extension and sidebar policies will no longer affect the appearance or functionality of Copilot Chat.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Additional meeting results in Copilot responses
items.description: Today, Copilot can show up to 25 meeting results, which can limit visibility in larger calendars. We’re expanding this limit so you can see more relevant meetings at once making it easier to find, review, and act on the full context you need.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends coverage beyond Microsoft data with third-party signals from partners like BigID, Cyera, OneTrust, and Varonis, giving security teams a single, streamlined view of sensitive data across clouds and platforms. Together, these innovations make DSPM the central hub for managing data security posture in the era of AI. We are also extending Data Risk Assessments to Fabric and to item-level analysis with new remediation actions like bulk disabling of overshared SharePoint links.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.
For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Proactive push notifications for the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
items.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will proactively send push notifications for common productivity workflows like 'Your Day at a Glance' and 'Items waiting for you', which send users to the respective Copilot response when opened. This feature taps into your Copilot Memory and will be available for users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses and can also be accessed once opening the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. Updated August 26, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Work Search Banner for Google
items.description: When a user performs a search on google.com from a work profile, Microsoft Edge can detect whether organization-specific results are available for that query. When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related information regardless of their search engine. Admins can control access to this feature using the EdgeWorkSearchBannerEnabled policy. Note: We have made the decision to cancel this planned release. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Power user insights in Copilot dashboard
items.description: Understand who is building a habit using Copilot with the new power user insights in Copilot dashboard

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
items.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description:
Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed. 
#copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Web App
items.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint just as you open the PowerPoint web app.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.149 - Modern, unified, and updated Look and Feel
items.description: Microsoft Edge will update the Look and Feel to give customers a unified experience across all of Microsoft AI surfaces including Copilot and Bing. This will change multiple elements of the UX such as spacing, corners, fonts, default colors, etc.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
items.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
items.description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher engagement and richer insights from surveys.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Copilot Chat leverages embedded images for richer, more accurate answers.
items.description: Copilot has been enhanced to interpret and ground responses using images embedded in files such as Word documents (.docx), PowerPoint presentations (.pptx), and PDFs. This capability allows Copilot to extract insights from visual elements like charts, diagrams, and screenshots, ensuring that answers are not only text-based but also informed by graphical context. By combining textual and visual understanding, Copilot delivers more comprehensive and contextually accurate responses for complex queries

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-AI app selection for Generative AI apps indicators
items.description: Customers can precisely choose which AI app they should use to detect any of the Generative AI apps indicators. This is applicable to the following indicators: "Entering risky prompts in Copilot", "Receiving sensitive responses from Copilot", "Entering risky prompts in enterprise AI apps", and "Receiving sensitive responses from enterprise AI apps". Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot now provides concise summaries with Outlook search results
items.description: Get answers to queries quickly with Copilot's concise AI summaries at the top of Outlook search results. Users can dig deeper by opening Copilot chat directly from the Copilot summary card.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
items.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.148 - Shadow AI
items.description: Currently admins can set Purview DLP policies to protect sensitive data from being sent to any Generative AI apps, users get blocked from sending their prompts to LLM when this is triggered and stops their workflow. This new add-on to the feature shows a new UI that will give users the option to be redirected to M365 Copilot which will open and navigate to this M365 Copilot tab and allow them to send the same prompt there.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot in File Previewer for iOS

items.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Find meetings based on topics and keywords
items.description: Copilot will be able to find meetings based on topics or keywords from relevant data like meeting body, chat and transcription.

items.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. items.description: AI and IT admins in Microsoft Admin Center can 1) gain visibility around oversharing risks and drive remediations 2) Understand how much of sensitive copilot interactions are protected and turn on Purview DLP for M365 Copilot right from there.
